prompt: Create an original 120 second fingerstyle acoustic folk instrumental composition for travel montage, walking and urban exploration. Mood: moving, bright, relaxed. Instruments: steel-string guitar, mandolin, light hand percussion. Style: alternating bass picking and a clear acoustic melody. Tempo approximately 100 BPM; E minor. Main idea: a descending melody with an upward answer. Use a forward-moving motif and recurring short instrumental answers. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:40] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:40-01:20] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:20-02:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 02:00.

description.en: A cheerful and light instrumental track featuring acoustic guitar, bass, and drums, with a pleasant, folk-inspired melody.
description.zh: 一首欢快轻松的器乐曲，以原声吉他、贝斯和鼓为主，旋律优美，带有民谣风格。
